cases.prompt: Two sensors estimate the same tissue displacement but their design matrix has nearly collinear columns. Explain why a tiny residual can coexist with unreliable parameter estimates, and propose one diagnostic or redesign.

rubric.criterion: Identifies ill-conditioning/collinearity
Connects it to large parameter changes under small noise
Suggests condition number, uncertainty analysis, or a more informative sensor geometry

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.
